row.evidence: Workleap's API overview says its user/group data model is based on SCIM but 'The Workleap API is currently not SCIM compliant'; automated provisioning is via HRIS, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 or Slack sync, or the Workleap API.
row.notes: Pingboard joined Workleap at the end of 2023 and pingboard.com/pricing now redirects to workleap.com/pricing; Pingboard is sold as part of the Workleap platform, so plans are Workleap's flat org-level tiers (Standard from $4,999 USD/yr, Pro from $11,999 USD/yr, Enterprise custom for 250+ employees), not per-user. June's Essentials ~$3-4/emp/mo estimate had no first-party source and the Essentials/Pro per-employee tiers no longer exist; dropped. Status changed from unknown to none: no SCIM endpoint is documented and Workleap says its API is not SCIM compliant. 'SSO' on Standard is Slack/Google/Microsoft sign-in; SAML SSO is a Pro feature. The legacy Pingboard catalogue apps (Okta OIN, last updated 2017; Entra provisioning tutorial requiring a Pingboard Pro account and the Pingboard API) predate the Workleap migration; Okta's OIN page ticks SCIM for the legacy app, which conflicts with Workleap's statement, so idp.okta is left null. API access (and so API provisioning) is a Pro feature on the pricing page.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Flat org-level price. 'SSO' row = Slack/Google/Microsoft 365 sign-in, not SAML. API access not available (comparison-table icon). User Provisioning (HRIS, Slack, Office 365, Google) included on all tiers.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Inclusion of SAML SSO and API access on Enterprise from comparison-table icons.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint documented. The Workleap API borrows the SCIM data model (urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User plus urn:workleap:params:scim:schemas:extension:user:2.0:User) but is not SCIM compliant.

user_api.notes: Pricing page lists API access from Pro (not available on Standard per comparison-table icon). SCIM-like JSON payloads with a Workleap extension (productAssignations, executiveAssignations, collaboratorAssignations, employeeIdentifier, bio, inviteOnMemberCreation).

capabilities.notes: invite_user via inviteOnMemberCreation; assign_roles/assign_licenses via executiveAssignations/collaboratorAssignations/productAssignations in the user extension.

limitations.text: The Workleap API is not SCIM compliant, so generic SCIM clients cannot use it.

okta.notes: Legacy Pingboard OIN app, last updated Dec 2017. OIN check icons show SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate (icons not quotable). Whether it still works after the Workleap migration is not documented by Workleap.

entra.notes: Legacy Pingboard gallery app; provisioning relies on the Pingboard API and needs a Pingboard Pro account. A separate SSO tutorial exists at pingboard-tutorial.

google.notes: Vendor-run daily Google Workspace sync configured in Workleap Settings > Provisioning; no Google catalogue app checked.

fallbacks.other_sync: Daily HRIS, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 or Slack sync run by Workleap; API provisioning (CSV or JSON)
